issues.subject: xiaozao
issues.fact: R6 sideburns end high and the lower hair stops above the requested neck coverage.
issues.impact: Missing requested length in side and pitched rear views.
issues.hypothesis: Spherical lower fill wraps inward; previous review checked gaps instead of endpoint landmarks.
issues.next_action: Keep checking these endpoints against ear lobe and neck when altering poses.
issues.change: Downward tapered continuous nape, longer connected sideburns, separate forehead protection.
issues.result: Lower-ear sideburns and neck-length rear fill are visibly present in sampled profiles and rear pitch. Shape quality remains under N04.

issues.subject: xiaozao
issues.fact: Old ears have white raised folds and a violet cavity, with overly broad frontal presentation.
issues.impact: Reads as an attached ornament rather than part of the face.
issues.hypothesis: Old ear palette and orientation no longer match final face treatment.
issues.next_action: Recheck ear lobe and shading when changing the face palette or hair occlusion.
issues.change: Opt-in shallow auricle, sparse dark folds, face-related skin color, revised local orientation.
issues.result: White ornament effect reduced; profile retains lobe and internal structure while front shows a narrower ear plane. This does not certify complete anatomical realism.

issues.subject: xiaozao
issues.fact: Frontal roots and fringe edges still feel coarse; user requires no wig effect and no recession.
issues.impact: Front framing remains below the requested naturalness.
issues.hypothesis: Visible edge largely belongs to the large fringe surfaces, not only the hidden cap.
issues.next_action: Redesign the exposed root-to-fringe transition as authored boundaries, preserving forehead height.
issues.change: Small unequal downward extensions at existing temple/cap/fringe borders; central anchor unchanged.
issues.result: No material frontal recession in compared views; edge changes are modest and do not eliminate wig feel.

issues.subject: xiaozao
issues.fact: The posterior/crown mass remains heavy and nape tips can still feel stiff.
issues.hypothesis: Large contour and highlight design remain inherited from the earlier coarse study.
issues.next_action: Use an authored side/back contour before another broad geometry expansion.

issues.subject: xiaozao
issues.fact: Some inherited light planes still read as bands with abrupt ends in profile.
issues.impact: Lighting does not fully describe the intended soft flowing mass.
issues.hypothesis: The highlight field is tied to inherited lock coordinates rather than a newly authored light design.
issues.next_action: Redraw and taper the selected light planes on the actual side and posterior forms.

iterations.change: Longer nape and sideburns, new ears, conservative frontal edge adjustment.
iterations.result: R1 rejected for cloth-like lower panel and overly long sideburns. R2 tapered the panel and shortened sideburns; R3 varied the lower hem but exposed thin old tips. R4 removed duplicate short-nape tips. R5 reduced the posterior main tip. Remaining hard mass and subtle front improvement are not accepted as benchmark quality.

misses.prior_judgment: R6 review emphasized connected dark color and visible ears.
misses.later_finding: User identified insufficient sideburn/nape length and odd ears, then required no hairline recession.
misses.lesson: Trace hair endpoints against ear lobe, jaw rear and neck; evaluate ear anatomy and palette separately from visibility. Preserve forehead anchors while refining edges.
misses.validation_status: Prompted local recheck and repair; no cross-character blind test.

misses.prior_judgment: A continuous downward fill should supply the missing length.
misses.later_finding: R1 actual rear view reads as a hanging rectangular cloth panel; sideburns are too long and needle-like.
misses.lesson: Length, taper, whole silhouette and old-tip overlap must be checked independently.
misses.validation_status: R2-R5 improve the panel and remove redundant tips; whole-hair rigidity remains.

reviewer_conclusion: Local ear and length improvements, no material frontal recession, but modest hairline gain and unresolved wig-like mass. Final MP4 inspected through six timestamped ordered-frame boards plus selected full views and detail crops; not realtime viewing or whole-episode acceptance.
